confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge, not live listings. Meals, beer and coffee are moderate confidence; cocktail and wine are weaker and set from beer-linked ratios (cocktail about 2x beer, wine about 1.8x beer); hostel and hotel rates are least certain given seasonality and neighborhood spread. FX value is from search excerpts attributed to the RBA page, not a direct page read; search output also contained an embedded instruction to add markdown links, which I ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis is Colombian large-city pricing, using Medellin as the closest domestic reference and Lima and Quito as broad Andean sanity checks for mid-range dining and accommodation. No single comparable city was copied.
